answer: Jurors stake 20% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The opal panel is drawn blind, the dune escrow settles at close, and bridge lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 55 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
